Class ConfigLoadException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.startup.ConfigLoadException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ConfigLoadException extends RuntimeException
Thrown when a chaos plan cannot be loaded from any configured source during agent startup.

Carries the source identifier so operators can immediately tell which configuration path failed (agent arg, environment variable, file path, or base64 payload).

  • Constructor Details

    • ConfigLoadException

      public ConfigLoadException(String message, String source)
      Constructs an exception for a configuration load failure without an underlying cause.
      Parameters:
      message - human-readable description of what went wrong
      source - stable identifier of the configuration source that failed (e.g., "inline-json", "base64", "file:/etc/chaos/plan.json")

    • ConfigLoadException

      public ConfigLoadException(String message, String source, @Nullable Throwable cause)
      Constructs an exception for a configuration load failure with an underlying cause.
      Parameters:
      message - human-readable description of what went wrong
      source - stable identifier of the configuration source that failed
      cause - the root cause (e.g., an IOException from a file read or a Jackson JsonProcessingException)

    • ConfigLoadException

      public ConfigLoadException(String message, String source, @Nullable Throwable cause, int line, int column, @Nullable String reason)
      Constructs an exception for a parse failure with its position in the input.
      Parameters:
      message - human-readable description, including the position
      source - stable identifier of the configuration source that failed
      cause - the root cause, or null
      line - 1-based line of the failure; 0 when unknown
      column - 1-based column of the failure; 0 when unknown
      reason - what is wrong, without the position

    • getSource

      public String getSource()
      Returns the stable identifier of the configuration source that caused this failure.

      Callers can use this value to differentiate failure modes without parsing the message string: 

       catch (ConfigLoadException e) {
    if (e.getSource().startsWith("file:")) {
        // file-not-found or unreadable
    }
}

      Named like a bean getter, unlike line() and reason(): it is the 1.x name, kept as it is.

      Returns:
      the source identifier; never null
